description: Fixtures for stage-level evaluation of reconstruct-reasoning -> verify-and-find-divergence -> classify-gap. Each case supplies already-extracted steps (bypassing OCR) so these can run against the deterministic verifier immediately, and against the classify-gap model call once a GEMINI_API_KEY is configured. Image-based fixtures (for read-and-extract / messy & ambiguous handwriting) belong in eval/fixtures/images/ with a matching manifest entry — not included here since none were available to attach in this session.

cases.subject: math
cases.note: KNOWN LIMITATION: verifyEquationStep only checks single-equation-to-single-equation transforms. A disjunctive final answer step ('x = -2 or x = -3') is out of scope for this deterministic check and must be handled by verifyFinalAnswer or a dedicated multi-root comparator instead — not yet implemented. Truncated to the algebra step this verifier can actually judge, rather than asserting a pass it can't back up.

cases.note: Narrative setup lines ('Let x = number of apples') are not equations and are out of scope for this equation-diff verifier by design — reconstruct-reasoning.ts (the Gemini stage) is responsible for normalizing word-problem setup into the equation chain before verification ever runs. This fixture tests only the post-setup equation chain.
